common.tagline: Your ward. Your vote. Your proof.
common.demoDataHint: You are seeing sample figures. Live county data appears once the county's database is connected.

a11y.simpleModeHint: No animation, lighter pages. Good for slow phones and weak signal.

home.title: Your county, out in the open.
home.intro: Report a problem, follow every shilling, and vote on what your ward builds next. From any phone.

wardCard.trustHint: 40% how fast reports are answered, 35% projects finished, 25% budgets kept.

home.phoneBody: Dial {code} on any phone to report a problem, check a case, vote or get alerts. No data bundles needed.
home.trustBody: You never need to give your name. We keep the ward, the category and your description. Public pages only ever show totals.
home.moneyBody: See what each ward was promised, what has been spent, and who is doing the work.
home.loopBody: Every report goes to a named department with a deadline. If the deadline passes, it climbs to a supervisor, and the overdue count goes on this page for everyone to see.

map.boundariesNote: Ward outlines shown are indicative until the county loads its official boundaries.
map.pinHint: Drag the map so the pin sits on the problem.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Tell {county} County what is broken. It takes about a minute. You do not need to give your name.
report.addPhotoHint: Optional. Up to 3 photos. We remove location details from photos before they leave your phone.
report.category: What kind of problem is it?
report.categoryHelp: Pick the closest one. An officer will check it.
report.sensitiveNote: This kind of report is sent to the county's integrity desk, not to the department it is about.
report.urgentNote: This is treated as urgent. If someone is in danger right now, call 999 or 112 first.
report.describePlaceholder: For example: A big pothole on the road next to the market. Matatus are swerving into oncoming traffic.
report.describeHelp: Please do not include names or phone numbers. We remove them anyway.
report.callbackBody: Optional. If you add your number we will text you when the status changes. It is stored separately from your report and never shown publicly.
report.callbackConsent: Yes, text me updates about this report.
report.callbackInvalid: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
privacyBullets: Your name is never asked for.
Photos are stripped of GPS and phone details on your device.
Public pages only show totals by ward and category.
The case reference is safe to share. It shows status, never your details.
report.successBody: It has been sent to the county. Keep this reference to check progress.
report.queuedBody: You are offline. Your report will be sent automatically when the signal returns. Keep this reference.
report.shareText: I reported a problem in {ward}. Case {ref}
report.errorRetry: Your report is safe on this phone. We will keep trying.
report.tooShort: Please add a little more detail (at least 12 characters).

status.title: Check a report
status.intro: Enter the case reference you were given.
status.notFound: We could not find that reference. Check it and try again.
status.linkedProject: This is part of a project
status.noUpdates: No updates yet. You will see them here as the county responds.

offline.banner: You are offline. Reports and votes are saved and will send when you reconnect.

footer.about: County Yangu is the public window into {county} County. It runs on CountyConnect, the county's own service platform.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped.
